title: A Pre-Registered a0(z) Gate for the Rubin/LSST Supernova Stream: Committing the Test Before the Data
description: A PRE-REGISTRATION, not a result. The de Sitter-Unruh MODIFIED-INERTIA framework ties the galaxy acceleration scale to the cosmological horizon (a0=cH_Lambda/Z; canonical 9.36e-11 / alt 1.13e-10 m/s^2; kernel nu=sqrt(1+1/y) is Milgrom's 1999 form, the distinctive content being the cH_Lambda/Z coefficient + a modified-inertia completion) and, under an adiabatic-horizon ansatz, makes the scale evolve with the dark-energy density: a0(z)/a0(0)=sqrt(rho_DE(z)/rho_DE0), CPL rho_DE. This document freezes, timestamps, and SHA-256 hash-stamps -- BEFORE any calibrated Rubin/LSST supernova cosmology exists (LSST began 2026-06-30; the LSST-DESC sample is not expected before ~2027) -- the complete procedure by which this prediction will be judged, so the test cannot be tuned to the data after the fact (the author's Gaia-DR4 frozen-cuts discipline, applied to Rubin). FROZEN ESTIMATOR (a0z_gate_estimator.py, exit 0): input a calibrated (w0,wa) posterior, Monte-Carlo it through the framework relation to R=a0(z=3)/a0(0), report the decline/rise significance, and apply PRE-COMMITTED thresholds -- A) GATE OPEN (distinctive prediction ALIVE): decline >=3 sigma AND R in [0.55,0.85]; B) GATE DISSOLVED (safe core, NOT falsification): consistent with flat -> constant-a0 MOND; C) FRAMEWORK STRAINED: R>1 (rise) at >=3 sigma; UNDECIDED otherwise. DATA HIERARCHY: the DESC calibrated SN cosmology sample is PRIMARY (~2027+); published Rubin w0wa is interim; a broker classified-SN-Ia count (broker_sn_counter.py; live ALeRCE ~36,836 now, past the ~4,400 spec-quality threshold, ~9% of the ~400,000 LSST photometric target) is a READINESS TRACKER ONLY and by frozen rule NEVER feeds the verdict. REFUSED (stated as a virtue): no do-it-yourself Hubble diagram from public broker light curves -- without DESC calibration any w(z) is systematics-dominated and a 'Rubin confirms a0(z)' claim on it would be a manufactured result. TWO SUBTLETIES DISCLOSED UP FRONT (the point of an honest pre-registration): (1) z=3 is beyond the SN range (z<=1.2), so R=a0(3)/a0(0) is a CPL EXTRAPOLATION -- the significance is really the significance with which the posterior excludes (w0,wa)=(-1,0); at z=1 the framework's a0 is essentially flat (R~0.99). (2) the framework's a0(z) is NON-MONOTONIC (a +3.6% bump peaking R~1.036 at z~0.35, crossing below 1 only at z~0.9, declining thereafter -- the committed 'bump-then-decline'), so the LOW-z galaxy-side test (resolved rotation curves) probes the RISING branch while the z=3 gate reads the declining branch; the matching galaxy-side confirmation is therefore the HIGH-z (z>~2) BTFR, and the two halves probe opposite branches of one curve. HONEST SCOPE (frozen): the gate settles the COSMOLOGY-SIDE question -- does a0 evolve at all -- which the framework INHERITS from w(z); GATE OPEN means the distinctive prediction SURVIVES, not that the framework is established; the corroborating test is the independent galaxy-side a0(z) (cross-scale, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21440407). STATE AT FREEZE: DESI DR2 2025 gives R=0.775 [0.68,0.88], 2.0 sigma -> UNDECIDED (below the 3 sigma threshold); the forecast (forecast_rubin_a0z.py) projects Rubin reaches 3.3 sigma (SN-alone) to 4.6-4.7 sigma (SN+CMB/BAO) IF DE evolves at the DESI-central rate, and excludes the framework's R at ~3.3-6.0 sigma if DE is flat. a0's value, Z, and the adiabatic-horizon promotion of a0~sqrt(rho_DE) are POSITED, not derived; both value footings collapse to the Z-independent R; the a0~sqrt(rho_DE) coincidence predates the framework (Limbach, Psaltis & Ozel 2008). No detection, no confirmation claimed; a hint is a hint. Every number is produced by committed, exit-0 scripts, hash-stamped in FREEZE_HASHES.txt.
notes: Referee-graded (draft -> physics/honesty+privacy/citation panel -> revise). The physics panel flagged as SEVERE, and the paper now DISCLOSES up front (freeze intact, hash-locked scripts UNCHANGED, only the narrative strengthened): (1) the z=3 gate is a CPL extrapolation beyond the SN range -> the gate is operationally 'does the posterior exclude w=-1'; (2) the framework's a0(z) is non-monotonic (bump-then-decline), so the low-z galaxy-side test and the z=3 cosmology gate probe opposite branches -- the matching galaxy confirmation is the high-z BTFR. Also: the [0.55,0.85] band de-gerrymandered (edges derived from w0, not the value footings, which cancel); the over-decline (R<0.55) UNDECIDED gap and the broker-count firewall documented; the value fork (cancels) distinguished from the evolution fork (sqrt(rho_DE) chosen vs rising cH*E(z), which would register as Verdict C). Framework flavor: canonical a0=9.36e-11 + alt, nu=sqrt(1+1/y), the horizon coefficient -- standard a0=1.2e-10 appears only as external context. Privacy: zero personal info beyond byline.
